Original Decipher card face for [[Sullust (Dark)]], rotated 180° from the archive scan [[:File:DS2-D-sullust-decipher-archive.gif]], no other change. Decipher's Dark Side card list scan shows this card Light Side up; this copy turns it so the Dark Side text reads the right way up. The rotation is lossless: same pixels and palette, no crop, no rescaling.

Source: [http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/deathstar2/dark/images/sullust.gif sullust.gif], Decipher.com card list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010903145242/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/deathstar2/dark/images/sullust.gif Internet Archive], 3 September 2001. SHA-256 of the archived file: 8511979422e0f6f42d8f9d505d259b68ed14d3c2f6e909bf6dcda8368529532d.

The PC Holotable face is [[:File:DS2-D-sullust.gif]] and is not replaced by this file.
